title: ClinicalTrials.gov Phase 3 Recent Updates
description: Snapshots Phase 3 (and Phase 2/3) clinical trial status updates from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API for the past 30 days. Each row identifies a trial with NCT ID, brief title, condition, intervention, sponsor, lead sponsor class (Industry / NIH / Other), overall_status (Recruiting / Active / Completed / Terminated / etc.), phase, primary_completion_date, last_update_date, enrollment count, and a market-impact tier (HIGH for status changes to Completed or Active-not-recruiting on industry-sponsored Phase 3; MEDIUM for new Phase 3 starts or completion-date shifts; LOW for routine recruiting updates). Powers the Public Health & Pharma Catalyst Brief: Phase 3 readouts move biotech / pharma equities 30-300% on success and 50-90% on failure - knowing the population of trials and their primary completion dates drives positioning. Free ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API, no auth. Round-6 (2026-05-02): fixed Phase enum filter - PHASE2_PHASE3 is not a valid value in the v2 API (allowed: NA, EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4) and was returning HTTP 400. Multi-phase studies have ["PHASE2","PHASE3"] in their phases array so PHASE3-only filter still matches them. Added structured api_status capture + sentinel-on-failure visibility.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
from_date = (now - timedelta(days=30)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
to_date = now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

BASE = 'https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'nct_id', 'brief_title', 'condition', 'intervention',
    'lead_sponsor', 'lead_sponsor_class',
    'overall_status', 'phase',
    'study_type', 'enrollment',
    'start_date', 'primary_completion_date', 'completion_date',
    'last_update_post_date',
    'impact_tier', '_epoch',
]

HIGH_IMPACT_STATUSES = {'COMPLETED', 'ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING', 'TERMINATED', 'WITHDRAWN', 'SUSPENDED'}
MEDIUM_IMPACT_STATUSES = {'RECRUITING', 'ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION', 'NOT_YET_RECRUITING'}

def classify_impact(status, sponsor_class, phase):
    s = (status or '').upper().replace(' ', '_')
    sc = (sponsor_class or '').upper()
    p = (phase or '').upper()
    is_phase3 = 'PHASE3' in p or 'PHASE_3' in p
    is_industry = sc == 'INDUSTRY'
    if s in HIGH_IMPACT_STATUSES and is_phase3 and is_industry:
        return 'HIGH'
    if s in HIGH_IMPACT_STATUSES and is_phase3:
        return 'MEDIUM'
    if s in MEDIUM_IMPACT_STATUSES and is_phase3:
        return 'MEDIUM'
    return 'LOW'

rows = []
api_status = 'ok'
api_detail = ''
next_token = None
page_count = 0
max_pages = 5
while page_count < max_pages:
    params = {
        'pageSize': 100,
        'fields': 'NCTId,BriefTitle,Condition,InterventionName,LeadSponsorName,LeadSponsorClass,OverallStatus,Phase,StudyType,EnrollmentCount,StartDate,PrimaryCompletionDate,CompletionDate,LastUpdatePostDate',
        # Round-6 fix (2026-05-02): PHASE2_PHASE3 is not a valid enum
        # value in the v2 API - allowed: NA, EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1,
        # PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4. The old form returned HTTP 400 with
        # the parser error, the bare-except swallowed it, parquet
        # written empty on every cron fire. Filter on PHASE3 only;
        # multi-phase studies have ['PHASE2','PHASE3'] in their phases
        # array so they still match.
        'filter.advanced': 'AREA[Phase]PHASE3 AND AREA[LastUpdatePostDate]RANGE[' + from_date + ',' + to_date + ']',
    }
    if next_token:
        params['pageToken'] = next_token
    try:
        resp = requests.get(BASE, params=params, timeout=30)
    except Exception as exc:
        api_status = 'fetch_error'
        api_detail = (str(exc) or '')[:200]
        break
    if resp.status_code == 400:
        api_status = 'invalid_filter'
        api_detail = (resp.text or '')[:300]
        break
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        api_status = 'error_' + str(resp.status_code)
        api_detail = (resp.text or '')[:200]
        break
    try:
        payload = resp.json() or {}
    except Exception as exc:
        api_status = 'parse_error'
        api_detail = (str(exc) or '')[:200]
        break
    studies = payload.get('studies', []) or []
    next_token = payload.get('nextPageToken', '') or ''
    if not studies:
        break
    for stdy_idx in range(len(studies)):
        st = studies[stdy_idx]
        if not isinstance(st, dict):
            continue
        proto = st.get('protocolSection', {}) or {}
        ident_mod = proto.get('identificationModule', {}) or {}
        nct_id = ident_mod.get('nctId', '') or ''
        brief_title = ident_mod.get('briefTitle', '') or ''
        cond_mod = proto.get('conditionsModule', {}) or {}
        conditions = cond_mod.get('conditions', []) or []
        condition_str = '; '.join(conditions[:3]) if isinstance(conditions, list) else ''
        arms_mod = proto.get('armsInterventionsModule', {}) or {}
        interventions = arms_mod.get('interventions', []) or []
        intervention_names = []
        if isinstance(interventions, list):
            for ii in range(len(interventions)):
                iv = interventions[ii]
                if isinstance(iv, dict):
                    nm = iv.get('name', '') or iv.get('interventionName', '')
                    if nm:
                        intervention_names.append(nm)
        intervention_str = '; '.join(intervention_names[:3])
        sponsor_mod = proto.get('sponsorCollaboratorsModule', {}) or {}
        lead_obj = sponsor_mod.get('leadSponsor', {}) or {}
        lead_name = lead_obj.get('name', '') if isinstance(lead_obj, dict) else ''
        lead_class = lead_obj.get('class', '') if isinstance(lead_obj, dict) else ''
        status_mod = proto.get('statusModule', {}) or {}
        overall_status = status_mod.get('overallStatus', '') or ''
        start_date_obj = status_mod.get('startDateStruct', {}) or {}
        start_date = start_date_obj.get('date', '') if isinstance(start_date_obj, dict) else ''
        prim_compl_obj = status_mod.get('primaryCompletionDateStruct', {}) or {}
        prim_compl = prim_compl_obj.get('date', '') if isinstance(prim_compl_obj, dict) else ''
        compl_obj = status_mod.get('completionDateStruct', {}) or {}
        completion_date = compl_obj.get('date', '') if isinstance(compl_obj, dict) else ''
        last_update_obj = status_mod.get('lastUpdatePostDateStruct', {}) or {}
        last_update = last_update_obj.get('date', '') if isinstance(last_update_obj, dict) else ''
        design_mod = proto.get('designModule', {}) or {}
        phases_list = design_mod.get('phases', []) or []
        phase_str = '; '.join(phases_list) if isinstance(phases_list, list) else ''
        study_type = design_mod.get('studyType', '') or ''
        enrollment_obj = design_mod.get('enrollmentInfo', {}) or {}
        enrollment = enrollment_obj.get('count', 0) if isinstance(enrollment_obj, dict) else 0
        impact = classify_impact(overall_status, lead_class, phase_str)
        rows.append({
            'nct_id': nct_id,
            'brief_title': brief_title[:300] if len(brief_title) > 300 else brief_title,
            'condition': condition_str,
            'intervention': intervention_str,
            'lead_sponsor': lead_name,
            'lead_sponsor_class': lead_class,
            'overall_status': overall_status,
            'phase': phase_str,
            'study_type': study_type,
            'enrollment': int(enrollment) if enrollment else 0,
            'start_date': start_date,
            'primary_completion_date': prim_compl,
            'completion_date': completion_date,
            'last_update_post_date': last_update,
            'impact_tier': impact,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })
    if not next_token:
        break
    page_count = page_count + 1

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values(['impact_tier', 'last_update_post_date'], ascending=[True, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    # Sentinel row when no studies returned - surfaces silent failures.
    sentinel_msg = 'No Phase 3 studies returned. api_status=' + api_status
    if api_detail:
        sentinel_msg = sentinel_msg + '; detail=' + api_detail[:200]
    df = pd.DataFrame([{
        'nct_id': 'INFO',
        'brief_title': sentinel_msg[:300],
        'condition': '',
        'intervention': '',
        'lead_sponsor': 'Diagnostic sentinel',
        'lead_sponsor_class': '',
        'overall_status': '',
        'phase': '',
        'study_type': '',
        'enrollment': 0,
        'start_date': '',
        'primary_completion_date': '',
        'completion_date': '',
        'last_update_post_date': now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
        'impact_tier': 'API_ERROR' if api_status != 'ok' else 'NO_SIGNAL',
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    }], columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
